newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary BUX hits high on Greenspan's words-analyst.
newsitem.headline: Hungary BUX hits high on Greenspan's words-analyst.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange opened at a new high on Wednesday, benefiting from upbeat comments by U.S. Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan on Tuesday, an analyst said.
The BUX index opened at 7,528.40 points, up from Tuesday's close of 7,439.09 and also above 7,491.07 points, the previous life high.
The index continued its rise after the opening and at 0958 GMT stood at 7,535.78 points, up 96.69 points or 1.30 percent.
"The rise is clearly the result of the Fed testimony," said Andrea Dicso of Bank Austria-Investment Rt. "Globally, markets reacted positively (to the speech)."
U.S. Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan said on Tuesday the Fed would raise interest rates if needed to head off inflation, but suggested that might not happen anytime soon.
Stock markets globally, including emerging markets where U.S. funds are key investors, generally benefit from steady U.S. interest rates.
